summary: First iteration testing complete for academic schedule processor. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests PASSED (upload, processing, CRUD on blocks, export, subjects dictionary, fuzzy search). Frontend: full E2E flow verified - upload page loads, file upload + processing succeeds, navigation to dashboard, ScheduleGrid renders 65 cells / 40 blocks, ExcelPreview renders 350 cells, BlockEditor opens, autocomplete fuzzy matching returns 10 suggestions, block update persists with confirmed (green) status and toast 'Bloque actualizado exitosamente'. Confianza global ~79.8% on real test file.

ui_bugs.issue: Anchor element used for download is not appended to document.body before .click(); may not trigger downloads reliably in all browsers (Playwright did not capture a download event). Real Chrome usually works but recommend appending/removing the anchor or using FileSaver pattern for reliability.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} (a11y warning from Radix Dialog)

action_items: (LOW) Make export download more robust: append anchor to document.body, click, then remove. This avoids edge cases where the click is not honored.
(LOW) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to BlockEditor DialogContent to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: subject_matcher is instantiated per request inside /api/subjects/search/{query}. Move to module-level singleton like ScheduleProcessor for performance.
server.py PUT/DELETE block endpoints fetch entire schedule and rewrite the full 'celdas' array. For large schedules this is fine but consider $arrayFilters-based atomic updates.
server.py: file extension check uses endswith on filename - could be bypassed; consider also validating MIME / openpyxl load.
Dashboard.js handleExport: DOM anchor not appended, may fail to download in some browsers.
No backend pagination on GET /api/schedules (uses to_list(1000)) - acceptable for now but document the limit.
test_credentials: N/A - public access, no auth required
